<div class="accordion-item"><h2 class="accordion-header"><button class="accordion-button collapsed" type="button" data-bs-toggle="collapse" data-bs-target="#work-acc-summary">Summary</button></h2><div id="work-acc-summary" class="accordion-collapse collapse"><div class="accordion-body">Vaijyantīkośa is a Sanskrit lexicon or dictionary primarily focused on providing definitions and explanations of Sanskrit words and their usage in various contexts, including in literature, philosophy, and everyday speech. Vaijyantīkośa is divided into two main sections: the Śabdaratnākara and the Artharatnākara.<br><br>The first section, the Śabdaratnākara, contains definitions of over 15,000 Sanskrit words, arranged alphabetically. Each entry includes information on the word's gender, number, declension, and conjugation, as well as its meanings and usage in various contexts. The second section, the Artharatnākara, contains more detailed explanations of the meanings of various words, as well as discussions of their philosophical and cultural significance.</div></div></div>
<div class="accordion-item"><h2 class="accordion-header"><button class="accordion-button collapsed" type="button" data-bs-toggle="collapse" data-bs-target="#work-acc-contents">Contents</button></h2><div id="work-acc-contents" class="accordion-collapse collapse"><div class="accordion-body">Vaijyantīkośa is primarily a lexicon or dictionary of Sanskrit words, arranged alphabetically, with their meanings and usage explained. It is divided into two main sections:<br>Śabdaratnākara: This section contains definitions of over 15,000 Sanskrit words, arranged alphabetically. Each entry includes information on the word's gender, number, declension, and conjugation, as well as its meanings and usage in various contexts.<br>Artharatnākara: This section contains more detailed explanations of the meanings of various words, as well as discussions of their philosophical and cultural significance. It includes entries on topics such as grammar, literature, philosophy, religion, mythology, and history.<br>In addition to the main sections, Vaijyantīkośa also includes an appendix with additional information on grammar, prosody, and metrics. The work is known for its comprehensive coverage of Sanskrit vocabulary, as well as for its detailed and nuanced explanations of the meanings and usage of various words.</div></div></div>
<div class="accordion-item"><h2 class="accordion-header"><button class="accordion-button collapsed" type="button" data-bs-toggle="collapse" data-bs-target="#work-acc-uniqueness">Uniqueness</button></h2><div id="work-acc-uniqueness" class="accordion-collapse collapse"><div class="accordion-body">Vaijyantīkośa is a unique work due to its comprehensive coverage of Sanskrit vocabulary and detailed explanations of the meanings and usage of words. Unlike other lexicons, it not only provides definitions but also includes discussions of the philosophical, cultural, and historical significance of the words. This makes it a valuable resource for scholars and students of Sanskrit language and literature, as well as for those interested in the history and culture of ancient India. Additionally, Yādavaprākāśa's poetic background and knowledge of prosody and metrics are reflected in his writing, adding a unique literary and aesthetic dimension to the work</div></div></div>
<div class="accordion-item"><h2 class="accordion-header"><button class="accordion-button collapsed" type="button" data-bs-toggle="collapse" data-bs-target="#work-acc-contribution">Contribution &amp; Notes</button></h2><div id="work-acc-contribution" class="accordion-collapse collapse"><div class="accordion-body">Vaijyantīkośa, authored by Yādavaprākāśa, is a valuable contribution to Sanskrit literature as it serves as a comprehensive lexicon that provides in-depth explanations of the meanings and usage of Sanskrit words. It is a significant resource for scholars and students of Sanskrit language and literature, aiding in the understanding of texts and enhancing the knowledge of the language. The work also offers insights into the cultural, philosophical, and historical significance of the words, making it a valuable resource for those interested in the history and culture of ancient India. The Vaijyantīkośa remains a significant and influential work in Sanskrit literature, demonstrating Yādavaprākāśa's knowledge and scholarship in the field.<br><br>Vaijyantīkośa is a significant contribution to the field of Sanskrit lexicography and linguistics. It is known for its extensive treatment of synonyms and their usage in different contexts, which makes it a valuable resource for scholars studying the nuances of Sanskrit language and literature. The work is also notable for its incorporation of ideas from various schools of Indian philosophy, including Sāṅkhya, Nyāya, and Mīmāṃsā, which adds a unique philosophical dimension to its linguistic analysis. Vaijyantīkośa is an important reference work for students and scholars of Sanskrit language and literature, as well as Indian philosophy and culture.</div></div></div>
